title: Assigned vertex labels
statement: Let $n,k,q$ be natural numbers, and let a tuple consist of $q$ subsets of an $n$-element set, each of size $k$, whose symmetric difference is empty. For each part, choose a permutation of the $k$ indices. The assigned label of the vertex at position $i$ in that part is the element in position given by the permutation, under the bijection from the $k$ indices to that part’s subset.
hypotheses_covered: The tuple has $q$ subsets of an $n$-element set
The tuple’s symmetric difference is empty
A permutation of the $k$ indices is chosen for each part
